verdicts.originalText: If Birgitta is already on the field (from a prior E or Q), Ineffa's Q in-game re-summons her at the new target location and resets her duration. The planner renders the burst-summoned Birgitta as a separate spawn — overlapping bars during E→Q within 20s should be read as 'Birgitta active throughout' rather than 'two Birgittas.'
verdicts.proposedText: Already-active Birgitta is re-summoned at the new spot with her duration reset in game, but the timeline shows a second overlapping bar. Read overlap within 20s as one Birgitta, not two.
verdicts.rationale: Real divergence: in game a recast re-summons the existing Birgitta and resets her duration, but summon re-summon/duration-reset is not wired, so the timeline over-spawns a second bar. Kept as rewrite (not implementDelete). Compressed ~330ch to ~185ch, stripped the character name (Ineffa) and switched 'the planner' to 'the timeline' voice; Birgitta is a kit summon proper noun and stays.

claimsLost.claim: The already-active Birgitta may have been summoned by a prior skill (E) or a prior burst (Q)

rubricRefs: CANNOT (summon re-summon / duration-reset is a real gap)

verdicts.originalText: C6 is gated on Carrier Flow Composite (the C1 buff active for 20s after each E cast) AND a Lunar-Charged reaction proc. The planner gates only on the reaction; without Carrier Flow Composite tracking, the C6 hit will over-render in rotations where E is on cooldown for >20s. Practically negligible since E is on a 16s CD.
verdicts.proposedText: In game this also needs the C1 buff (active 20s after each skill cast); the timeline gates only on the Lunar-Charged reaction, so the hit over-shows when over 20s pass without a skill recast. Negligible in practice — the skill's CD is 16s.
verdicts.rationale: Real CANNOT gap: no primitive to gate an effect on a self-buff status window, so the tool gates only on the reaction and over-renders when the C1 buff has lapsed. Kept as rewrite. Dropped the redundant 'C6' self-name (kind chip shows it), the character name, and 'the planner'→'the timeline'. Rephrased the confusing 'E on cooldown for >20s' as the true buff-lapse condition (>20s without a skill recast), traceable to 'C1 buff active for 20s after each E cast'. Preserved the negligible/16s-CD reassurance.

claimsLost.claim: The C1 buff referenced is named Carrier Flow Composite

demotedNotes: The C1 buff referenced in the C6 gating caveat is named Carrier Flow Composite (rendered as 'the C1 buff' for compression).
